- Fixed 2player local co-op hotbar bug

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3654760/9th_Dawn_Remake_Demo 

Tell your friends to check it out :D

notes.title: Item Transfer now available for Local & Online Multiplayer!!!
notes.content:
1.153 - 11th October 2024
—
- ITEM TRANSFER for Local & Online Multiplayer!!! Simply drag the item onto "Transfer to friend" button! See video: https://youtu.be/0-aLMPmY4-8
Please note that item transfer for ONLINE Mulitplayer has a cooldown time of 7 seconds. This is to ensure enough time to complete the transfer of the previous item, and save the game on both devices. If the item fails to be received (network problems), the original player should *hopefully* get the item returned back to them. Please note, this game is not a competitive PVP type game- this method can most likely be abused or exploited with hacks, and loss of item may occur if purposefully closing the app during the transfer to exploit it- IF you choose to try exploit it then you're only ruining it for yourself :D 
- Please do let me know about any legitimate bugs for the above though^

- EXP - Exp gain has been nerfed a small amount as people are still hitting max level too soon
- Card Game - Enemy boss HP reduced, and enemy HP reduced at higher levels overall
- Card Game - Enemy boss Attack reduced, and enemy Attack reduced at higher levels overall
